Question: Hi, We are looking for a groom for my sister, its getting very difficult to find a suitable guy,I don't know whether some enemy has done someting wrong for us that we are struggling so much. Is there any AMAL which can be performed for few days/weeks by which this problem can be resolved. And whomesover has done anything bad for us can be ignored or elimiated. I try to read surah yaseen daily. Jazaakumullah... Answer ID: 8486 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1353/199L/1429) Ask your sister to recite ya lateef ( یا لطیف ) 111 times after every obligatory salah with durood 11 times before and after. She shall get a match soon, in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
